create.name: Steve Nobel
create.bio:
Steve Nobel is a British author and channel whose work speaks to people who identify as starseeds and lightworkers. He spent a decade in international banking and another in local government before becoming a director of Alternatives, the long-running talks programme at St James's Church, Piccadilly, a post he held for thirteen years until the winter solstice of 2012. Since then he has worked independently under the name The Soul Matrix, teaching that humanity is moving through a shift in consciousness from a denser 3D way of living towards a more unified 5D one.

Most of his teaching comes as spoken transmissions, decrees, prayers and affirmations, calling on angelic, goddess and star-being imagery, which he releases on YouTube, as a podcast and in a free online library. Alongside these he sells recorded courses on themes such as the Universal Mind, the Atlantean Law of One and working with a higher self, runs a membership with twice-monthly online meetings, and gives one-to-one Soul Matrix sessions. His books include Personal Transitions, The Prosperity Game, Freeing the Spirit, Joy at Work and The Spiritual Entrepreneur, and he has created The Starseed Mirror Oracle.

books.title: Personal Transitions
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: A Findhorn Press book on the big turning points in a life and how to move through them, set against what he sees as a wider shift in consciousness on the planet.

books.title: Joy at Work
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: A reissue of The Enlightenment of Work, drawing on his own changes of career to look at finding meaning and purpose in working life.

books.title: The Spiritual Entrepreneur
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: Guidance for people building a business around spiritual work, with a meditation or transmission at the close of each chapter.

books.title: The Prosperity Game
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: His book on abundance and the inner side of money, written while he was a director of Alternatives in London.

books.title: Freeing the Spirit: Ancient and Modern Magical Techniques to Awaken Your Inner Potential
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: An early book, republished in 2022, that draws on Tantra, Wicca, shamanism, mysticism and psychology to explore personal growth and inner freedom.

books.title: The Starseed Mirror Oracle
books.author: Steve Nobel
books.description: The guidebook to his oracle for starseeds, with a short message and reflection for each card.

courses.title: Connecting with the Universal Mind
courses.description: A recorded course of meditations and teachings on the Universal Mind, the vast intelligence he sees beneath all things, drawing on mystics from several traditions.

courses.title: The Atlantean Law of One Course
courses.description: Recorded transmissions and teachings on the idea that every soul belongs to one divine source, and on living in line with that unity.

courses.title: Becoming Your Higher Self Course
courses.description: Nine video and audio tracks, a spoken decree and eight meditations, for deepening the connection with the higher self.

courses.title: Angelic Solfeggio Course
courses.description: Twelve transmissions invoking angelic and Elohim energies, each set to one of the Solfeggio tones, as video and downloadable audio.

courses.title: Channel Your Book Course
courses.description: Thirteen tracks of meditations, affirmations, exercises and talks for spiritual writers who want to work with inner guidance while writing.

courses.title: Angelic Light Affirmations Course
courses.description: Affirmation tracks built around six archangels, meant to be repeated over time to shift long-held beliefs.

courses.title: 5D Membership
courses.description: His membership community, with extra recorded material, two online meetings each month and a members' forum.

courses.title: Soul Matrix Healing Session
courses.description: A one-to-one online session of about ninety minutes using his Soul Matrix method, which works with past-life patterns and vows, with a card reading.

free_resources.title: Steve Nobel on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His meditations and transmissions on the Insight Timer app, free to play.

free_resources.title: Starseeds (free eBook)
free_resources.description: A free eBook setting out his view of the ascension process and the role of starseeds, given with sign-up to his newsletter and resource library.
